evidence: Matches the 'Utils/log/libs' label and edits src/util/fs.cpp to harden shared filesystem wrapper primitives.
rationale: Prevents file descriptor leaks by ensuring fsbridge::fopen sets close-on-exec/non-inheritable flags across platforms. The problem description notes handles 'remain inheritable across process boundaries by default, risking descriptor leaks into child processes executed by Bitcoin Core (such as external signers or notification scripts)'. This is worthwhile security hygiene and robustness for utility primitives, but deferrable as it is not actively causing critical failures.
